topic: Felix W17 FK-abort census — webhooks/delivery.ex reachability + fence verdict (origin/main 30efabd50)
verdict: REFUTE — delivery.ex fails the FK-abort-500 class on REACHABILITY: the FK-unconstrained Repo.insert runs inside a DETACHED, non-blocking, nolink supervised Task, decoupled from the user's HTTP request. A stale-ref Ecto.ConstraintError crashes a background delivery task and is logged; it NEVER 500s any write path (admin or non-admin). NOT buildable this wave. Do NOT slice.

shape_facts_confirmed.changeset_casts: Delivery.changeset (delivery.ex:51-70) casts endpoint_id + event_id; the ONLY constraint helper is unique_constraint([:endpoint_id, :event_id]) at L69 — NO foreign_key_constraint anywhere in the file (grep -nE 'foreign_key_constraint' returns nothing).
shape_facts_confirmed.migration_fks: 20260417230400_create_webhook_deliveries.exs: endpoint_id references(:webhooks, type: :binary_id, on_delete: :delete_all) null:false (L6-7); event_id references(:mutation_events, on_delete: :delete_all) null:false (L9). BOTH are real ON DELETE CASCADE (delete_all) FKs — matches the CORRECTED filter (CASCADE is still this class; a Postgres FK raises on INSERT against a missing/deleted parent regardless of on_delete).
shape_facts_confirmed.insert_is_nonbang: Webhooks.claim_delivery (webhooks.ex:289) uses NON-BANG Repo.insert(..., on_conflict: :nothing, conflict_target: [:endpoint_id,:event_id]). on_conflict::nothing suppresses the UNIQUE conflict only — an FK violation is a DIFFERENT constraint and would still raise.
shape_facts_confirmed.not_retryworker: RetryWorker.perform never calls claim_delivery; it resumes an EXISTING row via Dispatcher.redeliver/5 (retry_worker.ex:99). No FK insert on the retry path.

load_bearing_correction: The assignment premise #2 ('reached on the SYNCHRONOUS content-write dispatch path') is FACTUALLY WRONG. It IS the content-write dispatch path, but it is ASYNC/DETACHED. Chain: content write -> Content.Broadcast.maybe_dispatch_webhook (broadcast.ex:248/279, or the deferred flush at flush_deferred_broadcasts) -> Dispatcher.dispatch_async/6 (dispatcher.ex:70) -> fan_out/2 (dispatcher.ex:98) -> Task.Supervisor.start_child(Barkpark.TaskSupervisor, ...) wrapping async_stream_nolink on WebhookDeliverySupervisor -> deliver/3 (dispatcher.ex:285) -> claim_delivery -> Repo.insert. dispatch_async's own docstring: 'Spawns one supervised Task per matching webhook so a slow endpoint cannot block callers.' The user's HTTP content-write has ALREADY returned before the insert runs.
why_refute: The FK-abort class REQUIRES 'raises a raw Ecto.ConstraintError 500 on a REACHABLE non-admin write path.' Here the insert is fire-and-forget (start_child, not await; async_stream_NOLINK). A ConstraintError crashes the detached delivery task and is logged — there is NO 500 returned to any caller. The reachable-500 criterion is not met.

The doctrine GREEN is ALSO unreachable: deliver/3's {:error,_} branch return is discarded by Stream.run() inside the detached task. Adding foreign_key_constraint would convert a logged task crash into a silently-dropped {:error, changeset} — an internal robustness nicety, NOT the user-observable red(500)->green({:error,cs}) mutation proof the improvement-only doctrine demands. No HTTP caller receives EITHER outcome, so the mandatory red/green mutation proof cannot be built on a reachable path.

The stale window physically EXISTS (admin deletes a webhook endpoint, or a mutation_events row is pruned, between active_webhooks_for SELECT and the insert), but it only ever manifests inside the detached task — confirming the crash is real but never user-facing.

fence_ruling.distinct_file: delivery.ex (webhooks/delivery.ex) is a DIFFERENT file from payload_rebuild.ex — the W15 fence names 'webhooks payload_rebuild' (task-felix-w15-webhooks-recovery-poison-class touches PayloadRebuild catch-all + stuck_delivery_sweeper, NOT delivery.ex/claim_delivery).
fence_ruling.no_open_pr: gh pr list --state open --limit 100: only 3 open PRs (#5726 cli-install, #5716 felix-w16 wave-log docs, #2907 studio vitals). NONE touch webhooks/delivery.ex or dispatcher.ex.
fence_ruling.stale_branches_only: Two remote branches carry delivery.ex diffs but are NOT open PRs and NOT merged: origin/loop-epic/c5-webhook-delivery-log-replay-latency-r-4-p (last commit 2026-07-03) and origin/loop-epic/webhook-test-send-api-leg-ops-closers-sh-2 (last commit 2026-07-19) — abandoned/superseded loop-epic branches, no active collision.
fence_ruling.moot: Fence-clearance is MOOT because the reachability verdict already refutes buildability. Even fully fence-clear, there is no doctrine-valid slice here.

recommendation_for_decide: Record delivery.ex as a census REFUTE (detached-async: no 500 escapes; doctrine red/green unbuildable). Do NOT count it as a wave slice. If Decide wants defense-in-depth, a foreign_key_constraint could be added as pure internal robustness and FILED as a backlog child — but it does NOT meet the improvement-only reachable-500 bar and must not be presented as a mutation-proven slice (that would be the Rival-B manufactured-slice cardinal sin). This is the CLEANER, more template-shaped candidate on shape alone, which is exactly why the detached-async refute is the load-bearing finding: shape-suitability without a reachable 500 is not buildable.
e2_disagreement_note: This is a genuine reachability CALL where reviewer-2 disagreement could live: a reviewer reading only the changeset shape + non-bang insert (all class-positive) without tracing fan_out's Task.Supervisor.start_child would PASS it; tracing the detached spawn REFUTES it. The escape-hiding judgment is precisely 'is the insert on the request path or in a detached task.'
